title: Switched BoltOdds off
body: BoltOdds has been silent for 20 min because it refuses the key the engine holds (BoltOdds: the lines socket is not connected (BoltOdds refused the key (Free plan cannot access API))). Retrying cannot fix that and a new GitHub runner cannot either, so the engine switched BoltOdds OFF instead of erroring all day. To use it again: put a key on a plan that includes its API in Settings › APIs, send it to GitHub, then switch BoltOdds back on.
